subject: Communication
title: Dark EQ: When Emotional Skills Go Wrong
description: A short lesson to help you apply Dark EQ: When Emotional Skills Go Wrong.

hook.text: The most charming person in the room understood everyone's emotions perfectly — and used them as weapons.

buildup.text: High EQ without ethical grounding becomes a manipulation tool. Some researchers call it 'dark emotional intelligence.'

discovery.text: People high in Machiavellianism and narcissism often score high on emotional perception — they read others to exploit them.

twist.text: EQ training without values is dangerous. Teaching emotion-reading without empathy creates a more skilled manipulator.

climax.text: Ethical EQ requires both skill AND intention. The same abilities that create great leaders also create great con artists.

punchline.text: EQ is a tool. Like all tools, it depends on who holds it and why.

quiz.question: What is 'dark emotional intelligence'?
options: Using emotional skills to manipulate others
